title: A plug-in estimator of the non-iterative conditional expectation g-formula using long short-term memory models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27354v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The non-iterative conditional expectation (NICE) plug-in estimator of the g-formula can be used to estimate the causal effects of sustained treatment strategies, even in the presence of treatment-confounder feedback, under the assumptions of exchangeability, positivity, and consistency. In practical applications, parametric models are commonly used to estimate the joint distribution of confounders, treatments, and outcomes over time. As an alternative to parametric models, long short-term memory (LSTM) models, designed to capture both short-term patterns and long-range dependencies in sequential data, may better accommodate complex temporal dependencies among time-varying confounders, treatments, and outcomes. However, the validity of statistical inferences of a plug-in estimator based on LSTM models has not yet been investigated. translated_title: 基于长短期记忆模型的非迭代条件期望g公式的代入估计量
translated_abstract: 在可交换性、正性和一致性假设下，g公式的非迭代条件期望（NICE）代入估计量可用于估计持续治疗策略的因果效应，即使存在治疗与混杂因子之间的反馈关系也是如此。在实际应用中，参数模型通常被用于估计混杂因子、治疗和结局随时间的联合分布。作为参数模型的替代方案，长短期记忆（LSTM）模型专为捕获序列数据中的短期模式和长期依赖关系而设计，可能更好地适应时变混杂因子、治疗和结局之间复杂的时序依赖关系。然而，基于LSTM模型的代入估计量统计推断的有效性尚未得到研究。本文提供了原理性证明，即在一种类似于真实数据的复杂数据生成机制下……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次为基于长短期记忆（LSTM）模型的g公式非迭代条件期望（NICE）代入估计量的统计推断有效性提供了原理性证明，用于在存在时变混杂和治疗-混杂反馈的情况下估计持续治疗策略的因果效应。
en_tdlr: This paper provides proof of principle for the validity of statistical inference of a plug-in estimator of the NICE g-formula based on LSTM models, enabling estimation of causal effects of sustained treatment strategies in the presence of time-varying confounding and treatment-confounder feedback.
